title: BubbyCraft Deco
description: Decorative railway numbers, letters, HD variants, and special train-themed surprises for Minecraft railway builders.
body:
Bring a little extra polish to your Minecraft railway builds with Bubbdor’s Finest, a decorative train-themed mod made for builders, railfans, and anyone who loves adding tiny details that make a build feel alive.

This mod adds a growing collection of railway-style numbers and letters, perfect for decorating locomotives, rolling stock, stations, signs, sheds, yards, and more. Whether you are building a classic engine lineup, numbering your fleet, labeling platforms, or adding that final bit of charm to your railway world, Bubbdor’s Finest gives you more tools to make your builds stand out.

Features
Pixel-style train numbers inspired by classic railway aesthetics
HD / non-pixel versions for cleaner, sharper builds
Select letters for railway markings and signage
Great for locomotives, coaches, wagons, yards, stations, depots, and display boards
Works well alongside train-focused builds and Create-style railway projects
Includes a few special surprises for players to discover
Perfect For
Minecraft railway builders
Sodor-inspired worlds
Create mod train layouts
Roleplay railways
Model railroad-style Minecraft builds
YouTube builds, showcases, and tutorials
Players who want cleaner locomotive numbering and signage options
Notes

This is a decorative mod focused on giving builders more visual options for railway projects. More numbers, letters, signs, and railway details may be added in future updates.
